claims.live_value: Open-air garden dining near Padang Padang with real cultural programming — Barong nights, Sunday markets, kids welcome.
claims.quote: We also host signature programs such as Kampung Rasa a Sunday market featuring traditional Indonesian set menus
claims.note: Location (Padang Padang Beach Street), Sunday market (Kampung Rasa) and kids' corner are supported. 'Barong nights' is not mentioned anywhere on the official site (events listed: Archipelago Night, Bar Take Over) — founder to trim or replace with 'cultural performances'.

claims.live_value: Part of the ULU Tribe collective, Ulu Garden is the Bukit venue that treats an evening as more than a meal: contemporary Indonesian cooking in a tropical garden with live music most nights, Balinese dance and ritual events, a Sunday market, a kids' corner and leashed dogs welcome.
claims.quote:
Do you have live music performances?
Yes. Live music performances are available daily.
claims.note: Also supported: 'Monthly Rituals', 'Dogs are welcome with a leash', 'dedicated kids' corner', 'curated cultural performances from various regions across Indonesia'. Site says live music daily (stronger than 'most nights').

claims.live_value: A big garden room that runs from breakfast into the evening.
claims.quote: We are open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, from 7 AM until late.

claims.live_value: Food is seasonal and local-leaning (miso gnocchi, fresh rolls, rice bowls); programming changes weekly, so check their page for what's on.
